terminology_gap.evidence: Homepage is dominated by token-sale language, but AI responses are centered on delivery/logistics terms; no cited sources suggest the token sale framing is being used for delivery queries.
The site positions MovitOn as a DePIN platform, but AI engines appear to describe the category more broadly as logistics/delivery/blockchain without consistently using DePIN terminology.
Homepage uses 'P2P delivery' but AI language surfaces 'delivery', 'courier', and 'platform' more often, suggesting the term is not strongly adopted in responses.
The site emphasizes AI + Web3 smart contracts, while AI responses more often surface generic blockchain/logistics wording rather than this combined product descriptor.
Token utility is central on-page, but the dominant AI-visible topic cluster is delivery/logistics, not token utility or crypto participation.
Homepage highlights payment methods, but AI outputs are not surfacing payment/onboarding language; instead they focus on the delivery platform concept.

language_gap.site_context: Homepage headline leads with a token sale and a consumer analogy.

addressed.note: Homepage token-sale and ERC-20 language speaks directly to Web3 participants.

opportunity_gap.name: Everyday parcel senders
opportunity_gap.note: AI visibility exists in this segment, but it is not framed with a clear consumer-use-case page; the audit only found 10 responses here.

opportunity_gap.name: Delivery partners / drivers / couriers
opportunity_gap.note: Only 10 responses were captured for this segment, indicating underdeveloped AI relevance versus the delivery platform intent.

opportunity_gap.name: Logistics operators / fleet managers
opportunity_gap.note: AI does use logistics language, but the site does not appear to have strongly optimized operator-focused content.

opportunity_gap.name: Enterprise last-mile teams
opportunity_gap.note: Competitors like Deliveroo (55.0%), doordash (32.5%), and lalamove (22.5%) are more established in AI responses for mainstream delivery intent.

strengths: Own site is mentioned in 100.0% of responses, showing strong brand presence in the audit set.
Average rank of 2.25 for Moviton is very strong when it appears.
The site clearly differentiates with AI + Web3 + smart contract messaging.
The platform concept spans multiple payment rails and networks, which is a distinctive operational feature.
opportunities: Shift AI-facing language toward delivery/logistics outcomes to match the terms AI engines already use.
Create more non-crypto explainers so the platform can compete for practical delivery queries, not just token-sale queries.
Build topical authority around decentralized logistics, dispatch, courier coordination, and last-mile delivery.
Use competitor comparison content to capture traffic from Deliveroo, doordash, lalamove, and shipchain-related intents.
gaps: No cited sources were found, which limits AI trust signals and retrievability.
The homepage over-indexes on token-sale messaging, which may dilute delivery-platform relevance.
AI visibility is broad but not yet clearly segmented by use case across the two customer types.
Competitor presence is substantial: Deliveroo 55.0%, doordash 32.5%, vechain 32.5%, lalamove 22.5%.

content_priorities: Create a dedicated 'What MovitOn is' page that explains the delivery platform in plain language before mentioning MVON or token mechanics.
Publish use-case pages for 'Everyday parcel senders' and 'Delivery partners' with benefit-led copy, not Web3-first copy.
Add a 'How decentralized delivery works' explainer that translates DePIN, smart contracts, and dispatch into operational language.
Create comparison pages: 'MovitOn vs Deliveroo', 'MovitOn vs doordash', and 'MovitOn vs lalamove'.
Build a logistics/operator landing page focused on fleet routing, courier coordination, and delivery dispatch use cases.
link_building: Earn coverage from logistics and supply-chain publications that describe MovitOn as a delivery/logistics platform, not only a token project.
Pursue backlinks from DePIN and Web3 ecosystem directories with clear category labels and plain-English summaries.
Get listed on startup, crypto, and logistics directories using consistent entity naming: MovitOn, delivery platform, DePIN logistics.
Secure mentions in articles comparing decentralized delivery, last-mile logistics, and Web3 mobility platforms.
Build partnerships with courier, merchant, and logistics communities to obtain relevant contextual links from industry sites.
quick_wins: Rewrite the homepage hero to lead with 'decentralized delivery platform' and move token-sale copy below the fold.
Add FAQ schema targeting questions about delivery, couriers, dispatch, and how the platform works.
Insert a short plain-English definition of DePIN and Web3 smart contracts directly on the homepage.
Create internal links from the homepage to consumer, courier, and operator pages using the exact terms AI already uses.
Add a concise 'Why choose MovitOn' section with delivery outcomes, speed, transparency, and coordination benefits.
Ensure consistent entity signals across title tags, H1s, and metadata so MovitOn is associated with logistics first and token sale second.
